answer_1.quote: Abstractive summarization aims at reproducing the semantics and topics of the original text in a concise and fluent summary by paraphrasing.

answer_2.quote: We use ROUGE scores: ROUGE-1 (R-1), ROUGE-2 (R-2) and ROUGE-L (R-L) by F1.

answer_4.quote: We randomly select 50 samples from CNNDM and 50 samples from XSUM. We ask three human annotators who are native or proficient English speakers to score the generated summaries under 3 aspects: Grammatically correct (Gram.), Informativeness (Info.), Overall.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators scored each summary on grammaticality, informativeness, and overall quality.
